# Disable Movement Collision With Environment

Source: [wiki article 4509](../archive/4509.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Disable Movement Collision With Environment](../../api/actions/disable-movement-collision-with-environment.md).

<a id="wiki-4509-n1"></a>

- Disabling environment collision leaves floor collision enabled by default; Include Floors must be true to disable it as well.
